ModMetaData.name: Mechanical Visual Framework / 机械动态视觉框架
ModMetaData.author: Grey·Oviin/OpenAI Assisted
ModMetaData.description: Animation and rendering for mechanical models: rotation, elevation, recoil, lift and folding. Supports RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7. Load after Core and before mods that use the framework. Tools, tutorials and optional examples are available on GitHub. See Guide/README.md. 为机械模型提供转向、俯仰、后坐、升降和折叠动画。支持RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7，在Core之后、使用框架的MOD之前启用。制作工具、教程和可选示例可从GitHub获取，参阅Guide/README.md。
